PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 217
PRIVATE WILDLIFE RESERVE
RULES, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
31st May, 2023]
No.
SOP(WL)12-1/2008-IV, dated 26.5.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 32 of the Punjab
Protected Areas Act 2020 (XXIII of 2020), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to
make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Private Wildlife Reserve Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the context or subject
requires otherwise:
(a) "Department"
means Punjab Wildlife and Parks, Punjab;
(b) "Director
General" means the Director General Wildlife and Parks, Punjab;
(c) "exotic"
means the wildlife species not native to Pakistan;
(d) "hunting
season" means the months of calendar year during which hunting is
permissible as per the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and
Management) Act, 1974 (II of 1974);
(e) "indigenous"
means wildlife species native to Pakistan;
(f) "licensee"
means a person who obtains a permit from the owner of a private wildlife
reserve for hunting in the protected area of such private wildlife reserve;
(g) "management
agreement" means an agreement between the management authority of a
private wildlife reserve and the Administrative Department;
(h) "management
plan" means management plan as mentioned in rule 6 of the Punjab Protected
Areas Rules, 2022;
(i) "owner"
means a person who owns private land and is desirous to establish a private
wildlife reserve as a protected area for conservation and protection of
wildlife under the Act;
(j) "permit"
means a permit Issued by owner of a private wildlife reserve to a person for
hunting in the specified area of his private wildlife reserve;
(k) "rules"
means the Private Wildlife Reserve Rules, 2023; and
(l) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the rules.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Requirements
of private wildlife reserve.---(1)
The owner shall have the ownership and possession of the proposed land as per
the Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1967 (XVII of 1967) and possess the organizational
ability to manage the private wildlife reserve.
(2) For
the purposes of notification of private wildlife reserve, the application shall
contain:
(a) specification
of land showing the title of the property and bona fide possession of the land
comprising the area of the private wildlife reserve and document of ownership
duly verified by the concerned District Collector;
(b) declaration
of proposed area as wildlife reserve comprising of all the Khasras of land
record falling under the proposed area and that the area is a composite or
continuous block along with a certified copy of "Aks Shajra" duly
verified by the concerned District Collector;
(c) certificate
of registration as an organization, if applicable;
(d) proposed
draft management plan;
(e) copies
of Computerized National Identity Card; and
(f) draft
management agreement.
(3) An
officer of the Administrative Department, not less than Deputy Director, shall
examine the documents and survey the area to ascertain the suitability of
declaration of a private wildlife reserve. For the purpose of verification of
revenue record, the necessary report shall be required from the District
Collector of the district concerned.
(4) On
the recommendation of the Department, satisfying that all the conditions
mentioned in the rules are fulfilled, the Administrative Department may issue
the notification in terms of subsection (1) of section 12 of the Act for the
declaration of the private wildlife reserve.
(5) The
management of private wildlife reserve after the notification, shall be subject
to the approval of the management plan and execution of the management
agreement.
